title: 7 CMS Egress “Golden Seats”
description: U.S. Air Force Senior Airman Diego Castellon, 7th Component Maintenance Squadron aircrew egress systems journeyman, discusses inspecting, tracking and replacing critical B-1B Lancer ejection seat components at Dyess Air Force Base, Texas, Oct. 1, 2026. Castellon discussed the “Golden Seats” logistics model to emphasize how maintaining four pre-built, fully inspected spare ejection seats reduces supply chain delays and aircraft downtime while preserving the precision and quality control needed for B-1 readiness and aircrew safety. (U.S. Air Force video by Airman Luis X. Jauregui)
